thread:
harper: hi everyone, onboarding question — i need to toggle a staging feature flag and also get a scoped service account for a tiny load test. tried the console but it shows me as readonly. who should i ask? :wave:

micaela: welcome harper! :tada: for toggles you'll need a JIT ff-admin session. if the console shows readonly it usually means you're in `console-readonly` group only. did you submit the onboard access form? https://redwood.internal/onboard-access

harper: i did the form during day0 but it looks like the group add didn't happen. form returned success but console still readonly.

infra-bot: Onboard ticket created: INC-51234. Auto-provision attempted but group `console-operators` not found for user harper. Recommend manual add by people-ops.

mat: hey harper, cc'd. i'll manually add you to `console-operators` and pre-stage a JIT so once the group propagates you can request activation. what flag id + project?

harper: flag is `recommendation.v3_canary` in project `recommendation-staging`. small smoke test, 3k requests over 30m. also need SA with `inference.invoker, logging.writer` for the test runner. TTL 6h is fine.

mat: sounds good. adding group now. give it 5 mins and then hit the JIT form.

infra-bot: Group membership change queued: add harper -> console-operators. Propagation ETA ~5m.

harper: group landed, but the JIT form shows "no approvers available for project" error when i try to request the ff-admin window.

micaela: that's an org policy quirk — projects need at least one approver listed in the project metadata. i'll add @mat as project approver for the staging project.

mat: done — approver metadata updated. try again.

harper: JIT form accepted now. it asks for an approval note, what's a good short one?

mat: "Temporary ff-admin to validate recommendation.v3_canary via smoke test ENG-14222. Duration 6h. Reviewer: mat."

harper: requested JIT and asked for SA key.

devops-oncall: creating SA `sa-harper-staging` with roles: `inference.invoker,logging.writer`. TTL 6h. Vault path: `secret/data/onboard/harper/sa-staging`. Putting rotate policy in place.

devops-oncall: SA created and vaulted. Command used (internal example):
```bash
redwood-iam create-sa --alias sa-harper-staging --roles inference.invoker,logging.writer --ttl 6h --vault-path secret/data/onboard/harper/sa-staging
```

mat: approved the JIT in console. window opens in 10m. remember to document the run and disable the window early if you finish.

harper: got the vault path and the JIT window. flipping the flag now and will run the load test. quick question — where should i add the flag owner metadata so others know who to ping?

micaela: add a tiny PR to infra/feature-flags with fields: id, owner alias, short description, runbook link. tag `@platform-flag-owners` for review. if you want i can pair-review the PR.

harper: will do that after verifying results. thanks so much for the speedy help! :rocket:

infra-bot: Audit entry INC-51234 updated: JIT activated by mat for harper, SA issued, vault path secret/data/onboard/harper/sa-staging. All actions logged.

harper: tests passed locally. i'll open the PR with owner and experiment notes and attach the audit id to ENG-14222. thanks everyone :smile:
